results.title: Bad weather disrupts flights at several airports; two international flights diverted
results.content: Bharatpur, Surkhet and Bhairahawa airports remain closed, while poor visibility and low cloud cover affect operations at Kathmandu airport.

results.title: Nepali players take the lead in NPL’s Player of the Match awards
results.content: After two seasons of an even split, Nepali cricketers have edged ahead of overseas players, winning 38 of the 70 awards handed out so far.

results.title: Nepal and Bhutan propose dedicated COP31 agenda on 1.5°C warming in mountain regions
results.content: In a formal submission addressed to the UNFCCC, the Himalayan nations urge the inclusion of the proposed agenda item in the supplementary provisional agenda of COP31.

results.title: Nepal has the creativity and talent to build its own industries. What it needs is government support
results.content: The government must be a part of these endeavours, understanding how such businesses can save communities.

results.title: How Nepal’s diverse voices are shaping political awakening and responding to modern challenges
results.content: To channel great moments of awakening, we need political management: governing politicians and an opposition that cautions and advises.

results.title: Biratnagar set Sudurpaschim a daunting 106-run target
results.content: Biratnagar Kings scored 105 for two in a rain-shortened five-over match in the Nepal Premier League at the TU International Cricket Ground on Saturday.

results.title: Shabana Azmi on acting, equality and the power of cinema
results.content: In a conversation with Swastima Khadka at the Kathmandu Film Festival, the veteran Indian actor reflected on her journey from ‘Ankur’ to mainstream hits, her marriage to Javed Akhtar and the responsibility of women artists.

results.title: ‘Elephants in the Fog’ actor Pushpa Lama wins Asia Pacific Screen award
results.content: The actor was recognised for her portrayal of a member of Nepal’s marginalised kinnar community in Abinash Bikram Shah’s Cannes-winning film.

results.title: Nepal and Mauritius move closer to G2G labour agreement
results.content: Mauritius has agreed to proceed with Nepal’s proposal for a bilateral deal to recruit Nepali workers, with provisions aimed at reducing recruitment costs and protecting migrant workers’ rights.

results.title: Bad weather disrupts domestic flights from Kathmandu
results.content: Rain and poor visibility in Kathmandu and at several destinations have affected flights, with Lukla remaining inaccessible by air for a second consecutive day. International services remain unaffected.

results.title: Rain triggers landslides, washes away roads and disrupts travel across Nepal
results.content: Landslides have disrupted the Prithvi Highway, washed away a road diversion in Gorkha and buried a house in Kavre, while heavy snow has hit the Kanchenjunga region.

results.title: What’s on in Kathmandu Valley this week
results.content: From Halloween celebrations and live music to community runs, here’s what’s happening around Kathmandu Valley this week.

results.title: Police action in newsrooms draws widespread condemnation
results.content: A team from the Kathmandu Valley Crime Investigation Office first went to the office of the online news portal Nepal Press in New Baneshwar.

results.title: What Balendra Shah can learn from Zohran Mamdani
results.content: Nepal’s prime minister and New York City mayor both rode the same anti-establishment wave. But only one of them takes tough questions.

results.title: Dhangadhi FC partners with Kathmandu Sports Development Ventures to form Sudurpashchim Sports Ventures
results.content: The new joint venture, chaired by Upendra Mahoto, aims to expand into football, grassroots development, and women's sports.
